purpose: Repair a repository-history gap: Card 03's runtime and UI implementation was completed and independently accepted, but never committed to Git. WB.1 depends on it.

history_finding.what_happened: Card 04 (353738753dc082cb0fad88007f121d8a35c428ae, 'card 04: activate recovery fixes and close recovery sequence') committed only closeout projections and documentation — AGENTS.md, the HCP_* pack, docs/UNIFIED_BUILD_LIST.md and runtime/manifests/EXPORT_MANIFEST.json. It committed no runtime code. Card 03's runtime and UI slice was therefore never committed and survived only as an uncommitted working-tree layer.
history_finding.corroboration: data/agent_handoffs/WB-RECOVERY-04-recovery-drill-closeout/evidence.md line 26 records contemporaneously that Cards 01-03 deliverables were still untracked at Card 04 time.
history_finding.cards_01_02_status: already tracked at the baseline — tools/state/canonical_state.py and tools/state/recovery_packet.py, including the Card 04 R1 get_current_focus corrections
history_finding.classification: pre-existing repository-history omission, NOT a WB.1 implementation defect

wb1_dependency.why_wb1_could_not_be_committed_alone: WB.1's authentication work was developed on top of the uncommitted Card 03 layer and hard-depends on it.
hard_dependencies: runtime/ui/src/App.jsx imports ./SystemContext — a fresh clone without SystemContext.jsx fails the production build on an unresolved import
runtime/ui/src/api.js carries the System Context GET wrappers that SystemContext.jsx calls

requires_new_independent_review.reason: Card 04 correction-R1 post-image (current_focus rendering); R1 is still READY_FOR_CODEX_REVIEW
Card 04 correction-R1 post-image; 8 tests vs Card 03's 7

Card 03's hash also contained the unrelated Chroma embedded-health stream, which depends on the still-uncommitted runtime/chroma_health.py. Only the System Context blueprint registration was staged; the baseline Chroma check is retained.

auto_staged_deterministic_projections.generated_by: repository .git/hooks/pre-commit, from the authoritative spine DB
auto_staged_deterministic_projections.substantive_delta: generation timestamp, generator run id, DB state revision, recorded HEAD

reconstruction.method: Card 03 content rebuilt deterministically from baseline 3537387 plus the isolated Card 03 hunks, then hash-verified against the Card 03 evidence BEFORE staging
reconstruction.staging: Git index only (git hash-object -w + git update-index --cacheinfo); the developer working tree was never overwritten and still carries the full WB.1 implementation
reconstruction.no_backup_snapshot_existed: every *.HEAD-preimage file in the WB.1 bundles is a copy of the Git HEAD version, not the Card 03 working tree — confirmed because workbench_auth.py.HEAD-preimage is 0 bytes, that file being untracked at HEAD
reconstruction.nothing_invented: content that could not be established from evidence was not fabricated; it is committed as-found and explicitly marked REQUIRES NEW INDEPENDENT REVIEW

tests_run_fresh.note: fresh runs, not historical numbers; raw output in test_output.txt

remaining_blockers: The three files listed under requires_new_independent_review have never been independently reviewed at their committed content.
Card 04 correction-R1 remains READY_FOR_CODEX_REVIEW; that review is still outstanding and covers the SystemContext.jsx/.test.jsx content committed here.
runtime/chroma_health.py and its container_app.py integration remain uncommitted, a separate stream out of scope for this repair.
WB.1's own implementation is still uncommitted; it is unblocked by this commit but not yet frozen.
